summary.text: Rick Garcia is the Democratic incumbent in the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 76, who took office on December 1, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served on the Marion County Commission and was selected as its president in 2019.

paragraphs.text: Garcia won the Democratic primary for District 76 on May 14, 2024, and defeated Republican Jon Dodds in the November 5, 2024 general election, 3,568 votes to 3,432.
He was unopposed in the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Dodds again in the general election.
